description: Pigne — Colore: Blue spruce & silvery gold Collezione: Wake Into The Dream Codice: 5943 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Small Altezza: 138.5 cm Rapporto: 34.5 cm × 36 cm Toni: Blue-green PIGNE is one of Mariano Fortuny's later designs — an intertwining pinecone motif whose arabesque complexity seems to grow rather than repeat. Prickly, layered, and abstract, its structure echoes the Sacred Geometry of the pinecone . Across cultures and centuries, the pinecone has symbolized fertility, spiritual consciousness, and everlasting life — a symbol that the pattern translates into a textile surface without reducing it to ornament. The medium repeat makes PIGNE technically versatile: it reads as a layered botanical field on large surfaces, and as a precise, jewel-like motif on smaller applications. Part of the WAKE INTO THE DREAM collection .
